original: 今の仕掛け、びっくりしたなぁ。\nまさか横に開くなんて……
traducao: That trap earlier really startled me.\nTo think it would open sideways...

original: 心理トラップって奴さ。\n扉っていったら、大抵は\n押し引きするタイプの奴が一般的だろ？
traducao: It's what they call a mind trap.\nWhen people think of doors, they usually\nexpect them to push or pull open, right?

original: その先入観を利用して、まるで\n開かずの扉の様に見せかけるってわけさ
traducao: By exploiting that preconception,\nit looks just like an impassable door.

original: 先入観か……ふむふむ
traducao: A preconception, huh... Hmm, hmm.

original: じゃあ、人に知られたくない内緒の扉は\n全部さっきみたいにしとけば\nいいって事なんだね！
traducao: Then if you want a secret door hidden,\nyou should just make every single door\nopen sideways like that one, right?!

original: いや、全部そうしちまったら\n仕掛けが一般的になっちまうだろ……
traducao: No, if you make every door like that,\nthe trick just becomes the new norm...

original: 辛かった日も、楽しかった日も\n自分には宝物……かぁ
traducao: Painful days and joyful days alike\nare all treasures to oneself... huh.

original: いい言葉だね！
traducao: That's a really wonderful phrase!

original: そ、そうかい？
traducao: Y-You think so?

original: うん。\nだって辛い事があったら\nつい否定したくなるのが普通でしょ？
traducao: Yeah.\nAfter all, when painful things happen,\npeople usually want to deny them, right?

original: 忘れたりとか、誤魔化したりとか
traducao: Like trying to forget or brush them off.

original: でも、しいなは違うんだね
traducao: But you're different, Sheena.

original: そういうのも\n全部宝物に出来るんだ。\nすごいよ
traducao: You're able to make all of that\ninto your own treasures.\nThat's really incredible.

original: ……それを教えてくれた友達がいたんだよ。\n逃げてばかりだったあたしを、体を張って\n叱ったり、励ましてくれたんだ……
traducao: ...I had a friend who taught me that.\nWhen I was constantly running away,\nthey put it on the line to guide me...

original: その子のおかげで\n今のあたしがここにいるのさ
traducao: Thanks to that friend,\nI'm standing here today.

original: へぇ〜、そうだったんだ……
traducao: Whoa... is that so......

original: その友達って、すごい人だったんだね！
traducao: That friend must be an amazing person!

original: ……ああ、そうだね……
traducao: ......Yeah, they really are......

original: 多分、一生頭が上がらないよ
traducao: I'll be in their debt my whole life.

original: 何？\nオレの顔に何か付いてる？
traducao: What is it?\nDo I have something on my face?

original: 前から思ってたんだけどさ。\nな〜んか、どっかでカイルに似たのを\n見た様な気がするんだよね
traducao: I've been thinking about this a while.\nI swear I've seen something somewhere\nthat looks just like you, Kyle.

original: ぎくっ！
traducao: Gulp!

original: 何だろう……う〜ん
traducao: What could it be... Hmmm.

original: えっと、ほら、オ、オレなんて\nその辺にいくらでもいる顔って\nいうか…
traducao: U-Um, well, you see...\nI have the kind of face you can find\njust about anywhere, you know...?

original: 世界には似た顔の人間が\n何人もいるって話だし
traducao: People say there are several folks\nwith identical faces in the world!

original: あっ、わかった
traducao: Ah, I've got it!

original: えっ！？
traducao: Huh?!

original: 栗だ！！
traducao: A chestnut!!

original: く……栗？
traducao: A... A chestnut?

original: ほら、そのツンツン頭がさ。\nあたしの里の栗の木が\n毎年付ける実にソックリなんだよ
traducao: See, that spiky hair of yours!\nIt's the spitting image of chestnuts\ngrown back in my home village every year!

original: 懐かしいねえ
traducao: Takes me right back.

original: 似てるって……そっち？
traducao: THAT is what looked like me?!

original: 何だか、あっという間に\n随分遠い所まで\n来ちまったよなぁ……
traducao: Somehow, in the blink of an eye,\nwe've come such a long, long way\nfrom where we started......

original: 何だい、いきなり。\n随分しんみりしてるじゃないか
traducao: What's with you all of a sudden?\nYou're sounding pretty sentimental.

original: 無理もないさ。\nリッドはもともと食事と睡眠が仕事みたいな\n生活をしていたんだ
traducao: It is only natural. Reid used to live\nas though eating and sleeping were\nhis full-time occupation.

original: 世界の為に先陣を切って戦うなんて、\n本来は一番縁遠い人間だろうな
traducao: Taking the lead to fight for the world\nis the last thing you'd expect of him.

original: 何だよ、その言い方。\nオレの事、馬鹿にしてんのか？
traducao: What's that supposed to mean?!\nAre you making fun of me?!

original: まあまあ、いいじゃねえか。\nとにかくこうして、おれ達はみんなで\n力を合わせて戦ってる
traducao: Come on, take it easy. The point is,\nwe're all here right now, joining our\nstrength together and fighting.

original: それは多分、多くの人の助けや\n未来に繋がる戦いなんだとおれは思う
traducao: I believe this fight will help many folks\nand lead toward a brighter future.

original: 確かに、ちっとばかしスケールのでかい\n話になっちまったかもしれねえが
traducao: Sure, the scale of things might have\ngotten a little out of hand, but...

original: 結果的にみんなが幸せになるんなら、\nおれは最後まで戦うぜ
traducao: if it makes everyone happy in the end,\nthen I'll fight until the very end!

original: いつも思うけど……
traducao: I've always thought this, but......

original: ティトレイって、たまに\n物語の正統派主人公みたいな事\nごく自然に言うわよねぇ〜
traducao: Tytree, you sometimes say things like\na classic storybook hero without even\nbreaking a sweat, don't you~?

original: でも、そうね。\nあんたのそういう考え方\n嫌いじゃないわよ
traducao: Still, you have a point.\nI certainly don't dislike\nthat way of thinking of yours.

original: 顔も知らない、だけどこの世界に\n確かに存在している誰かの為に
traducao: For people whose faces we do not know,\nyet who truly exist in this world...

original: そして、何よりも\nあたし達自身の為に……
traducao: And above all else,\nfor our very own sakes......

original: きっちり戦い抜こうじゃないか。\nあたし達に出来る、精一杯でさ
traducao: Let's see this fight through to the end,\ngiving it everything we have!

traducao: Yeah. If we're gonna do this,\nwe might as well give this tale\nthe happiest ending possible!
